svg.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Geography optional — the map decides, the models anchor
strongest GS-1/Prelims overlap · largest syllabus · diagram discipline is the scoring engine
PAPER 1 — PHYSICAL + HUMAN
Geomorph: plates · isostasy (Airy/Pratt) · landform cycles
Climatology: heat budget · jets · fronts · monsoon lineage
Oceanography: currents · ENSO · corals · Law-of-Sea edge
Soils · biomes (Whittaker) · environmental frames
Human: determinism→possibilism→neodeterminism
Population: Malthus/Boserup · demographic transition · migration
Models: von Thünen · Weber/Losch · Christaller · Zipf
formula: process → landform/consequence → example → diagram
PAPER 2 — INDIA + PLANNING
Physical: structure-relief · antecedent drainage · monsoon coupling
Vegetation · soils · agro-climatic regions
Population & migration belts · census towns · fringe dynamics
Agriculture (cropping regions, irrigation, watershed) · industry
Corridors & ports (DMIC, waterways) · energy transition geography
Planning: regions · 371-series asymmetries · reorganisation
Contemporary: floods · urban heat · river-linking · smart cities
formula: spatial vocabulary + scheme anchor + India map
TWELVE-WEEK FIRST PASS + DAILY DRILLS
wk 1-3 geomorph+climatology · wk 4 ocean+bio · wk 5-6 human+models · wk 7-9 India core · wk 10 planning/issues · wk 11 map-intensive · wk 12 PYQ map
daily: 1 India map + 1 diagram (15 min) · pre-rehearsed shelf: plates, ITCZ shift, conveyor, rings, hexagons, DT pyramid
